bash.name: bash
bash.description: Execute a bash command through this Member's confined terminal face and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh confined shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Every path the command names is admitted against the compiled read lane before the shell starts; a refused read returns no bytes and names the typed refusal code in its error.

command.description: The bash command line to run (`bash -c`).

description.description: One short sentence describing what the command does.

workdir.description: Optional working directory; absolute, or relative to the session cwd.

subagent.name: subagent
subagent.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. It runs in the background by default and returns a subagent id you can continue with `send_message`; you are notified when the run settles.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The complete, self-contained task for the subagent. It does not share this conversation's context, so include everything it needs.

run_in_background.description: Defaults to true. Set false only when your next action depends on the result.

subagentFork.name: subagent_fork
subagentFork.description: Delegate a task to a subagent that inherits this conversation: a child agent seeded with all completed turns so far (it does not see the current in-flight turn). Use this when the subtask builds on this conversation's context — a follow-up analysis, a review, a continuation — without consuming this conversation's context for the work itself. You receive its result, not its intermediate steps. It runs in the background by default and returns a subagent id you can continue with `send_message`; you are notified when the run settles.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The task for the subagent. It already sees this conversation's completed turns, so build on them freely and state only what is new.

run_in_background.description: Defaults to true. Set false only when your next action depends on the result.

teamCreateMember.name: team_create_member
teamCreateMember.description: Create a NEW member instance from a blueprint template (explicit creation; the activation authority enforces quota, envelope, and gates).

rootSessionId.description: The TeamSession (root session) id this operation belongs to.

requestToken.description: A token unique to THIS logical operation (non-empty, max 128 chars). Reuse the exact same token only when retrying the same logical operation; never reuse it for a different one.

delegationTemplateId.description: The blueprint template id the new member is created from.

label.description: A short human-readable label for the new member instance (non-empty).

groupId.description: Optional group id for the new member.

workspace.description: Optional workspace path override for the new member.
